_pin.redactions: 4 'describe' strings that named a cedant, payer, TPA or reinsurer were reworded (dim_life: Payer Name, MasterCedantName; fact_claims: Claimed, RI Name). Columns, types, keys and the version are verbatim.

_note: Output contract of the interim pipeline (Stage B) = input contract of the Power BI model (IP4). Premium tables are written by the IP2 workflow; claims tables are the IP3 target. Main tables: <name>.csv or <name>.parquet in one folder; recon_*, exceptions*, run_manifest* always CSV. Dates yyyy-mm-dd; numbers '.' decimal, no thousands separator.

describe.LifeID: v7.2.0: whole-number key of the life-period (1..n over LifeKey, UWY; numbered afresh each run): the key the dashboard joins Member Month and Claims on
describe.LifeKey: Payer|TPA|policy key|member key (keys normalised: upper case, trimmed, '_' '-' '/' removed; member key also '.' and spaces)
describe.Payer Name: Payer: the booking entity of the file (file register) [example redacted for the data boundary]
describe.Risk Carrier: Risk carrier from the collated file
describe.MasterCedantName: Master cedant (user input in every Alteryx workflow) [run value redacted for the data boundary]
describe.UWY: Underwriting year = year of policy coverage start
describe.PolicyEndAdj: Policy end after the TPA expiry convention (last covered day)
describe.AnnualBasisDays: Days in the policy year from inception (365/366): life-year denominator
describe.CovStart: First covered day of the life-period
describe.CovEnd: Last covered day of the life-period
describe.Periods: Coverage periods of the member in the term (after supersedes)
describe.EarnedDays: Covered days up to the valuation date
describe.ZP_Gross: 1 if the life-period's gross premium is non-zero (else no exposure counted, SPEC 3.7)
describe.ZP_Net: 1 if the life-period's net premium is non-zero
describe.WrittenLY_Gross: Written life-years = CovDays / AnnualBasisDays x ZP_Gross
describe.EarnedLY_Gross: Earned life-years = EarnedDays / AnnualBasisDays x ZP_Gross
describe.WrittenPrem_Gross: Sum of the life-period's gross premium rows (additions, refunds, corrections)
describe.EarnedPrem_Gross: Gross premium earned to the valuation date (each row daily pro-rata over its own period)
describe.RI Name: Reinsurer: standard value from the inputs workbook, else the raw value upper-cased
describe.Policy Type: Policy type: standard value from the inputs workbook, else the raw value upper-cased
describe.PolicyTypeUsed: Policy type used: supplied, else SME if group size <= 250
describe.Relation: Relation: standard value, else the raw value upper-cased
describe.Marital Status: Marital status: standard value, else the raw value upper-cased
describe.Network: Network: standard value from the inputs workbook, else the raw value upper-cased
describe.GroupSize: Distinct members on the policy term
describe.NewRenewal: New / Renewal (v6.4 evidence rule; Unknown before v6.4)
describe.NewRenewalSource: master contract link / member continuity / inception date / no link to the prior UW year; first UW year: inception date / raw column / endorsement type / first UW year, no evidence
describe.Joiner: 1 if cover starts after the policy start
describe.Leaver: 1 if cover ends before the policy end
describe.Tenure: UWY - first UWY of the master contract in the data
describe.EndoGroup: Endorsement-logic grouping, one per life-period, first match in this order: No coverage period, Void ab initio (every period void), Reinstated (policy reactivation), Member reactivation, Closing row without opening, Re-opened (overlap), Cancelled, Deleted, Addition in force, Initial/Renewal in force
describe.EndoPath: Periods in order as Opening>Closing, ' | ' between periods; '(void)' = closed on or before its start; Closing: open, Deletion, Cancellation, Overlap
describe.VoidPeriods: Periods void ab initio (closure on or before the start, incl. overlap closures, R1)
describe.OverlapVoidPeriods: Periods voided by an overlap closure on their own start day (R1)
describe.ReinstatedPeriods: Periods reopened by a policy reactivation (R2: only members closed by the cancellation)
describe.MemberReactPeriods: Periods opened by a member reactivation
describe.Region Group: Health authority from the inputs workbook (e.g. HAAD / DHA / MOH); no rule = the raw value, upper-cased; empty = Not Available
describe.Nationality Group: Nationality group from the inputs workbook (GCC Arab / Other Arab / Indian-Subcontinent / Asian / Western Expat / Other; tab Nationality groups); a spelling with no rule = Other; empty = Not Available
describe.Gender Group: Male / Female / Maternity Eligible Female (female aged 18-45 at inception); no rule = the raw value, upper-cased; empty = Not Available

describe.EarnedDays: Covered days in the month, up to the valuation date
describe.EarnedLY_Gross: Earned life-years in the month (gross zero-premium rule)
describe.EarnedPrem_Gross: Gross premium earned in the month
describe.EarnedPrem_Net: Net premium earned in the month
describe.WrittenPrem_Gross: Gross premium booked in the month (member-start month; refunds in the refund month)
describe.WrittenLY_Gross: Written life-years booked in the period-start month

fact_claims.grain: claim line (reversals netted within ClaimID upstream or kept as lines; sums are additive)

describe.UWY: UWY of the matched life-period; else of the policy term holding the treatment date; else the claims file UWY; else the treatment year (Q-C1)
describe.LifeID: v7.2.0: LifeID of the linked life-period (dim_life); blank = not linked (Ambiguous)
describe.ClaimID: Claim identifier (Q-C5): TPA|policy|member|treatment date|provider|ICD|payer share#n (n = running number of identical lines)
describe.MatchTier: T1 policy + member, in cover / T1 policy + member, out of cover / T2 member + treatment date / Ambiguous / Unmatched
describe.InCover: 1 if treatment date within a coverage period
describe.InExperience: 1 if treated on or before the valuation date (Q-V1); 0 = in recon only
describe.StatusClass: Paid / Outstanding (claim status of the source sheet, claims_map.json)
describe.Claim Type: As supplied (claims status / approval decision column); a pivot only, nothing excluded (Q-C7)
describe.FOB: Benefit class (field of benefit), standard value from the Value maps tab (Out-Patient / In-Patient / Maternity / Dental / Optical / Psychiatry / ...)
describe.FOC: Sub-class (field of cover), standard value from the Value maps tab
describe.ICD Code: Diagnosis code split from the supplied value (ICD-10 with the dot after the 3rd character, or ICD-9); Not Available when the value holds no code (NAS gives chapters)
describe.ICD Description: Description of the code from the ICD codes tab of the inputs workbook (CDC ICD-10-CM), else the text supplied after the code
describe.ICD Chapter: ICD-10-CM chapter of the code (ICD codes tab), else the supplied chapter by the 'ICD Chapter' rules (NAS)
describe.Provider Type: Standard value from the Value maps tab (Hospital / Clinic / Medical Center / Pharmacy / Diagnostic Center ...)
describe.ReportedMonth: Reporting date, else processed date, else payment date, else (outstanding) the claims extract month
describe.PaidMonth: Payment date, else processed date (paid lines; blank if unpaid)
describe.Claimed: Amount claimed (blank: not in the source claims files) [cedant name redacted]
describe.Paid: Payer share of the paid sheets
describe.OS: Payer share of the outstanding (OS) sheets
describe.CountFlag: 1 on the first line of a visit (TPA, policy, member, provider, treatment date) whose payer share totals > 0 (O7)
describe.LargeFlag: 1 if the visit's payer share >= run.json large_claim_threshold (O8: AED 100k)
describe.MasterCedantName: Master cedant (user input in every Alteryx workflow)
describe.RI Name: Reinsurer from the claims file [TPA/reinsurer example redacted]
describe.DevLag: Months from the incurred month to the claims extract month
describe.CF_Basis: IBNR basis (factor applied to paid + pending): IBNR, or No factor (CF = 1) when the TPA has no IBNR factors. never the text None, which pandas and other readers turn into a blank
describe.CF_Amount: IBNR amount completion factor of the TPA and lag (inputs workbook; 1 if none or beyond the last lag)
describe.CF_Count: IBNR count completion factor likewise (1 if no count factors are supplied)
describe.UltimateAmount: Claim-level ultimate, IBNR basis: (paid + pending) / CF_Amount
describe.UltimateCount: Claim-level ultimate count, IBNR basis: CountFlag / CF_Count
describe.Provider Region Group: Provider region mapped by the Region rules of the inputs workbook (DXB / AUH / NE / Not Mapped)
describe.CF_Basis_IBNP: IBNP basis (factor applied to paid): IBNP, or No factor (CF = 1) when the TPA has no IBNP factors (v5.15)
describe.CF_Amount_IBNP: IBNP amount completion factor of the TPA and lag (1 if none or beyond the last lag)
describe.CF_Count_IBNP: IBNP count completion factor likewise (1 if none)
describe.UltimateAmount_IBNP: Claim-level ultimate, IBNP basis: paid / CF_Amount_IBNP
describe.UltimateCount_IBNP: Claim-level ultimate count, IBNP basis: CountFlag on claims with a payment / CF_Count_IBNP

cf_selected.grain: TPA x Basis (Reported/Paid) x Measure (Amount/Count) x Lag 0-12

describe.Basis: IBNR (applied to paid + pending) or IBNP (applied to paid)
describe.Lag: Months from incurred month to claims extract month
describe.CF_Used: Completion factor from the inputs workbook
describe.Source: Inputs workbook (placeholder / synthetic placeholder when the Note says so)

ultimates.grain: Payer x TPA x incurred month x UWY (reported claims keep their UWY; IBNR allocated to UWY by earned premium of the month, SPEC P5.7)

describe.Lag: Months from the incurred month to the claims extract month
describe.CF_Used: Amount completion factor at the lag (1 if none)
describe.Reported: Reported payer share (paid + outstanding), in experience
describe.Ultimate: Sum of the claim-level ultimates (fact_claims UltimateAmount) of the cell
describe.UltimateCount: Sum of the claim-level ultimate counts of the cell
describe.PaidCount: Claims paid (CountFlag on claims with a payment)
describe.CF_Used_IBNP: IBNP amount completion factor at the lag (1 if none)
describe.CF_Count_Used_IBNP: IBNP count completion factor (1 if none)
describe.Ultimate_IBNP: Sum of the claim-level IBNP-basis ultimates (fact_claims UltimateAmount_IBNP) of the cell
describe.UltimateCount_IBNP: Sum of the claim-level IBNP-basis ultimate counts of the cell

recon.shape: one row per TPA, one column per measure (IP2 recon_premium.csv); unpivoted on load

describe.<measure>: One column per control total; unpivoted to Measure / Value

describe.Code: Finding code (E- stop, W- flag, I- info)
